text:
simon: Rolling v2.4.1 to eu-prod now. Deploy bot started smoke synthetic run. Noticing early failures on embed-synth at 512 tokens (~15% error). Tagging @tess for investigation.

deploy-bot: Deploy bot report: smoke-suite started 2026-03-20T12:13:09Z, tests: embedding-512, text-gen-256, kv-probe. embedding-512: 85% success, mean latency 210ms, errors 15% (503/timeout).

tess: On it. Can you paste a failing request/trace? I'll check routing and model variant pinning.

simon: Here is a sample failing curl: `curl -X POST https://eu-api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-4b","input":"hello"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'` Response: 503 backend unavailable.

tess: Checking canary logs... I see KV cache miss spikes around the same window. Looks like a caching layer misconfig during the rollout. Pushing a config tweak to restore old prefix cache size. Rolling that change to 10%.

leo: If cache tweak reduces errors, we should avoid full rollback. Also considering pinning traffic to redwood-embed-4b-stable variant. How's latency on the stable variant?

simon: Stable variant latency: 250ms mean but 99th at 480ms. Errors ~1%. Current rolling variant is faster avg but flaky under concurrency.

anya: Agree with pinning to stable for now. Can we do 50/50 split while we stabilize cache? That keeps performance and limits blast radius.

tess: Applied cache size revert to 10% canary. Deploy-bot smoke-run requeued for canary nodes. Will watch for 5 mins, then increase to 50%.

deploy-bot: Update: canary 10% cache-revert applied. New synthetic run: embedding-512 success 96%, mean latency 230ms, errors 4%. Scheduled increase to 50% in 5m if stable.

ops-oncall: Heads-up: this change will increase token cost slightly due to extra cache misses; fine with me for stability. Please add a note to release notes about temporary pinning and cache revert.

simon: Added note to release notes draft: 'v2.4.1: temporary pin to redwood-embed-4b-stable and cache size revert to mitigate post-deploy embed failures. Monitoring ongoing.'

tess: :thumbsup: keeping oncall and infra looped. If metrics regress after 50% bump, we'll rollback to previous deploy.

ci-bot: Post-deploy synthetic alert subscription created for this thread.
